transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Well… it’s a little embarrassing to say. I know it probably sounds awful. But sometimes after I’ve eaten too much, I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. I kept telling myself it was just a mistake, but it’s been happening enough now that it scared me. I thought I should come in before it gets worse… if that makes sense.
How often have you made yourself throw up after eating too much?

I… I wish I could say it was just once in a while, but that wouldn’t be honest. For the past several months, it’s been most weeks that I have one of those secret eating spells and then I go make myself sick afterward. I know that probably doesn’t sound good… but I can’t really call it occasional anymore.
Do you usually make yourself vomit after these eating episodes to avoid gaining weight?

Yes… usually, yes. I’m not proud of it. After I eat too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m scared of gaining weight. I kept telling myself it was just a slip or a one-time mistake, but… it’s happened enough that I know that’s not really true anymore.
